values.note: Unserviced $30 a night, and the equine sites $30 plus $5 a horse (county); glamping $50. The county prices camping '+ GST' while Alberta Parks' fee guidelines say GST included. Day-use passes ($5 a person, 5 and under free) are for day visitors.

note: Alberta Parks recreation area on the north side of Machesis Lake, ~55 km west of Fort Vermilion off Hwy 58 near Rocky Lane, run by Mackenzie County with seasonal caretakers: drive-in sites among jack pine, spruce and poplar, two fishing docks (rainbow trout), cook and picnic shelters, and eight equine sites with horse pens, hitching posts and manure bins. A general campground that also offers horse sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 27 unserviced sites at $30, season May 15 - Sep 30, leased to Mackenzie County (caretaker 780-927-2509, stored), booked on Let's Camp (max 40 ft, 14 nights). Added season opens, tax (+GST per the county), max length, facilities, booking platform/url. NOTE CORRECTION: the old note's 'swimming pond/beach' and 'stocked fish pond' are not on the Alberta Parks, county or Let's Camp text for Machesis; the county page gives exactly those for Zama City Community Park ('a swimming pond with beach area, stocked fishing pond'). Dropped. (Let's Camp's amenity tags do include 'swimming' and 'shower', but no description supports a shower and Alberta Parks lists none.)

OHV: Let's Camp's amenity tags include 'ATVTrails' (with biking, boatLaunch, fishing, groupCamping, horse use). Neither Alberta Parks nor the county mentions ATVs or an ATV trail system; Let's Camp's prose mentions only 'sandy trails on horseback'. Read as a general campground with an OHV side - stays, reported for the reviewer.
EQUINE: 'eight equine sites equipped with horse pens, hitching posts, and manure bins' within a general 27-site campground - not a horse camp.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): on Esri imagery the campground's clearings lie east of the lake, the nearest about 60-160 m from the shore with forest between; the docks and launch are on the north shore. Nothing within 50 m with open ground.

PIN (stored 58.32567,-116.57551 = the Alberta Parks directions point): sits in the campground's cleared loops east of the lake - no move. Let's Camp's own point (58.3248409,-116.5855089) is in the lake, ~590 m west; do not use it.
